Independently confirmed in current items/lem-finite-rank-operators-are-compact.md, ## Statement, lines 27–29: The Statement embeds wikilinks for boundedness, finite-dimensional range, and compactness. Both assigned examples depend on this lemma; the links should follow the complete Statement in a Statement references section. The current five-step proof places the bounded image of the unit ball in s times the finite-dimensional range unit ball, s=||T||. That ball is compact and its continuous scaled image is compact and closed in Y; taking a closed subset proves compactness. If s=0, both image and scaled ball are {0}, including zero range with the empty ordered basis. The assigned examples supply explicit finite coordinate bases.
